items.item_text: 01. Do you possess a California Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) certificate, OR California POST certified basic course certificate or equivalent, OR confirmation letter from a POST certified basic course academy showing enrollment and expected graduation date? NOTE: Certificate/License/Confirmation Letter information must be clearly stated in the 'Certificates and Licenses' section of the application and a copy uploaded with the application. Options: I posess a California Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) certificate. | I possess a POST certified basic course certificate or equivalent. | I possess a confirmation letter from a POST certified basic course academy showing enrollment and expected graduation date. | I DO NOT possess any of the above.
02. Do you possess a valid California Driver's License? Options: Yes | No

EXPERIENCE: Must be 21 years old.
